footnote_text: Represents restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted to the reporting person on September 25, 2026 as compensation for service as a director. The RSUs will vest on the earlier of (1) the date of Equipmentshare.com Inc's annual meeting of stockholders in 2027, (2) one year from the date of grant, or (3) a change of control, each subject to the reporting person's continued service as a director on the Board of Directors of Equipmentshare.com Inc through the vesting date.
